## Historical audit: S0182

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file; offsets cover each complete observation.

| Aspect | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Task and intended scene | The student was asked to reconstruct an indoor RGB photograph as separate Blender/SceneAct meshes, matching geometry, colors, materials, viewpoint and framing; a 512 × 341 reference image was supplied by path. This is the requested goal, not evidence of the image’s contents or a successful reconstruction. (Student `model_request`, JSONL line 1, chars [0,5608).) |
| Actual operations and changes | A fresh, read-only Codex session was launched with the staged image; the session reports zero tool calls and failed with exit code 1. No student program, scene modification, build or render is visible. (Student `codex_session`, line 2, [0,2614); `model_error`, line 3, [0,538).) |
| Validation and outcome | The harness traceback shows failure during the student model request. This is a **technical interruption**, not an established algorithmic failure or an independently verified empty patch. No visual or geometric validation, score, or successful submission is recorded. The underlying stderr contents are not included, so the cause of exit 1 is unknown. (`scene_error`, line 4, [0,1600); line 3, [0,538).) |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution, or evidence of student adoption appears in this trace. No autonomous exploration is visible; zero tool calls does not establish what occurred inside unexposed inference rounds. (Lines 1–4; session metadata at line 2, [0,2614).) |
| Scene-specific checks | There is no visible reconstruction or accessible image content here with which to verify multiple objects, materials or textures, part connections, pose, camera, lighting, or rendering. The instruction to create separate meshes is not evidence that they were created. (Line 1, [0,5608); lines 2–4.) |

**Transferable lesson and uncertainty:** A failed model invocation can stop the scene workflow before any build or review; distinguish that interruption from reconstruction quality. The task-specific image, stderr details, any unseen inference, and any downstream outcome remain unknown. No hypothesis about particular scene defects is supported by the visible record.
